summary: Build grant budgeting, burn-rate, eligibility, and audit documentation skills. Enrol in practical donor compliance training today.
lede: Donor Grant Budgeting and Compliance for Project Teams helps you turn an approved grant budget into an active control throughout the project lifecycle. You will learn to interpret donor eligibility rules, map expenditure to budget lines, monitor burn rate, verify supporting records, and explain variances through a clear audit trail. Practical exercises cover control matrices, direct and indirect cost classification, expenditure testing, budget revisions, and Power BI or Excel monitoring dashboards. Using COSO, OECD DAC terminology, donor agreement controls, and expenditure verification methods, the course connects transaction evidence with programme progress and donor reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who approve, record, monitor, verify, or explain expenditure under externally funded programmes. It suits beginner to intermediate practitioners who need a structured grant budgeting workflow and experienced staff who want to strengthen control evidence.
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to project budgets, financial transactions, procurement records, or donor-funded programme administration. Basic spreadsheet skills, including formulas, filters, and pivot tables, will help you complete the exercises. No programming is required, and you do not need prior knowledge of COSO, IPSAS, IFRS, IATI, or ISO 19011. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted document review and Power BI dashboard design are taught at operational application level, with configuration demonstrations rather than technical engineering.
